title: Andersen Search and Rescue
description: Because Guam is entirely surrounded by water; the Navy, Air Force, Coast Guard, and other agencies have the unique responsibility of assuring Guam's waters are as safe as possible. A1C Adam Harder reports how these joint forces work together in the search-and-rescue effort at Andersen Air Force Base.  Soundbites include AWS2 Lucas Voie, Naval Aircrewman and TSgt Richard Benavente, NCOIC Andersen Fire Department Training Section.  Produced by Airman First Class Adam Harder.
